description: Fetch the deterministic as-of financial snapshot with strict provenance metadata. By default returns the most recent statement of each type; filter by statement_type, fiscal years or fiscal_period, or set latest_only=false and page with cursor. Each statement returns its identity, filing and its figures as values and units, one entry per metric code; detail=true adds its facts, per-metric provenance and quality block. snapshot_hash always identifies the full snapshot; full_snapshot_url returns the snapshot's reconciliation and data-quality summaries. replay_token lets anyone re-check the page later: quote it with each figure and its accession, and give the reader verify_url.

as_of.description: A date (YYYY-MM-DD), which includes filings the SEC dated on or before it, or a timestamp with an offset (e.g. 2023-11-02T16:00:00-04:00), which includes filings the SEC accepted at or before it.

cursor.description: Opaque next_cursor from the previous page. Pass it with the same arguments to read the next page of the same snapshot.

detail.description: When false (default), each statement carries its figures as values and units, one entry per metric code. When true, each statement also carries its facts, per-metric provenance and quality block.

fiscal_period.description: Return only statements for this fiscal period (FY for annual).

fiscal_year_from.description: Return only statements with fiscal_year at or after this year.

fiscal_year_to.description: Return only statements with fiscal_year at or before this year.

include_lineage.description: When true, a period with a restated statement also returns the statement as first reported, so the two can be compared (the HTTP as-of audit_mode). Default false returns one statement per period.

include_usd.description: When true, each statement also carries usd: its money values in US dollars, with the rate, the rate's dates and its source (the HTTP as-of include_usd); with detail=true each money fact carries its own usd as well. A value over a period converts at the average of the Federal Reserve Board's H.10 daily rates over that period, a balance-sheet value at the rate on its date, using only rates published by as_of. values stay as filed. Default false.

latest_only.description: When true (default), return only the most recent statement of each statement type within the filters. False returns every matching statement, a page at a time.

statement_type.description: Return only statements of this type.

name: financials_get_as_of_snapshot
